 <strong>intersect</strong> - Intersection of two sets of data
    This MATLAB function returns the data common to both A and B, with no
    repetitions.

    Syntax
      C = <strong>intersect</strong>(A,B)
      C = <strong>intersect</strong>(A,B,setOrder)
      C = <strong>intersect</strong>(A,B,___,'rows')
      C = <strong>intersect</strong>(A,B,'rows',___)
      [C,ia,ib] = <strong>intersect</strong>(___)

      [C,ia,ib] = <strong>intersect</strong>(A,B,'legacy')
      [C,ia,ib] = <strong>intersect</strong>(A,B,'rows','legacy')

    Input Arguments
      <a href="matlab:web /Applications/MATLAB_R2025b.app/help/matlab/ref/double.intersect.html#btcnv0o-1_sep_shared-AB">A,B</a> - Input arrays

        'sorted' (default) | 'stable'

    Output Arguments
      <a href="matlab:web /Applications/MATLAB_R2025b.app/help/matlab/ref/double.intersect.html#btcnv0o-1-C">C</a> - Data common to A and B
        vector | matrix | table | timetable
      <a href="matlab:web /Applications/MATLAB_R2025b.app/help/matlab/ref/double.intersect.html#btcnv0o-1-ia">ia</a> - Index to A

      <a href="matlab:web /Applications/MATLAB_R2025b.app/help/matlab/ref/double.intersect.html#btcnv0o-1-ib">ib</a> - Index to B
        column vector
